data:
SELECT
BP_ID [refId],
  SRC_SYS [channel],
  DEALER_NAME [name],
  BP_NO [bpId],
  seller_status [status],
  address [address],
  DISTRICT [subDistrict],
  PROVINCE [province],
  POSTAL_CODE [postCode],
  REGION_NAME [region],
  OPENING_HOURS [openingHours],
  OPENING_HOURS_SPECIAL [openingHoursSpecial],
  TELEPHONE [phones],
  LOCATION_LINK [mapUrl],
  MAP_FILE [mapFileUrl],
  CONTACT [contact],
  SHOP_STATUS_TEXT [noteStatus],
  SHOP_OPTIONAL [textsecondaryStore],
  TRAVEL [directionTip],
  SELLER_REGION_CODE [saleAreaCode],
  SELLER_PRICE_GROUP [saleGroupCode],
  CUSTOMER_GROUP_CODE [customerGroupCode],
  CUSTOMER_GROUP_NAME [customerGroupName],
  FORMAT(CREATED_DT, 'yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.fffZ') [createdAt],
  FORMAT(UPDATED_DT, 'yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.fffZ') [updatedAt]
FROM ODSDWHAPI.COMN_SELLER
WHERE (DEALER_NAME LIKE :search OR address LIKE :search OR DISTRICT LIKE :search OR PROVINCE LIKE :search OR REGION_NAME LIKE :search) AND SRC_SYS IN (lower('HOFM'),lower('HOLN')) AND PROVINCE IN (lower('bangkok'))
ORDER BY UPDATED_DT DESC, BP_ID ASC
OFFSET 20 ROWS FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY
